transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Anthropic is in talks with India's tech ministry to make AI models available for safety testing and wants binding transparency rules. Still open, per ThePrint.
The creators of Apache Ranger launched an AI agent security guide series for CISOs evaluating enterprise agent controls. Confirmed by EIN Presswire.
Burger King's AI chatbot Patty monitors cashiers as workplace surveillance expands, though evidence of performance gains remains limited. Confirmed, per The Conway Daily Sun.
ServiceNow launched AI Passport for AI agent governance alongside a partnership with Nvidia. Reported by Constellation Research.
DeepSeek's API outage lasted nearly 5 hours and the company is offering full refund compensation. Reported by 正观新闻.
Free every hour.
